players.product: fiber array units (DR4 / DR8 / MT-FAU, PM fiber arrays for CPO), thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) modulators and chips, isolators, circulators and WDM modules for data-center optical modules

quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 results (quarterly report): Q3 revenue RMB 829,428,272.68, up 106.45% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 142,293,129.42, up 124.30%; excluding non-recurring items RMB 133,015,439.14, up 208.08%. First nine months: revenue RMB 1,861,090,478.54, up 86.41%; net profit attributable RMB 290,689,104.66, up 152.10%; excluding non-recurring items RMB 264,466,641.73, up 212.09%; R&D expense RMB 160,054,950.22, up 39.65%. The company attributes the revenue growth mainly to continued growth in demand for high-speed optical modules and optical devices from global AI data center construction, new product launches and new domestic and overseas customers, and the profit growth to scale effects and cost reduction.

quarterly_data.signal: Securing materials (quarterly report): prepayments rose 626.27% to RMB 117,092,552.79 at September 30, 2026, mainly larger prepayments to core material suppliers to secure supply as production scale expanded; inventory rose 71.93% to RMB 621,396,545.26 on the larger scale and on stocking core materials in advance; operating cash flow for the first nine months was RMB -130,414,943.00 (down 301.26%), mainly because core materials were bought ahead; right-of-use assets rose 144.82% on new plant and dormitory leases and other non-current assets 77.52% on equipment prepayments.
